|lore=Rogue pilot. Outlaw starship tech. Has secret lab in Mos Eisley. He bragged about beating Han Solo’s Kessel Run record. Left fringe life behind after meeting Obi-Wan Kenobi.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to Cantina, a docking bay, or a starship. BoShek is a matching pilot for any starship. Twice per game, may take a device into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.

|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[BoShek (V) (Virtual Set 1)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploys - 2 to any docking bay, starship or Cantina. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Considered "matching pilot" for any starship. Twice per game, may take a device into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[BoShek (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata)]]): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploys - 2 to Cantina, docking bays, or starships. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Twice per game, may take a device into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Considered "matching pilot" for any starship. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' “any” → “Cantina,”; “bay, starship” → “bays,”; “Cantina.” → “starships.”; moved “Considered "matching pilot" for any starship.” to a different place in the text.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to Cantina, a docking bay, or a starship. BoShek is a matching pilot for any starship. Twice per game, may take a device into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' removed “Deploys - 2 to Cantina, docking bays, or starships.”; added “Deploys -2 to Cantina, a docking bay, or a starship. BoShek is a matching pilot for any starship.”; removed “Considered "matching pilot" for any starship.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153847/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards1.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 01. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[BoShek]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy#Cards|Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
